ns2:course.label: Accounting and Accountancy II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ACCY 201 with focus on strategic management of economic resources, together with acquisition of such resources, and financial and non-financial measures of organizational performance. Credit is not given for both ACCY 202 and ACCY 200. Prerequisite: ACCY 201 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both ACCY 202 and ACCY 200. Prerequisite: ACCY 201 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
